name: Buipui Full-System AI-Assisted Optimised Protocol
scope: All Buipui system families, engines, native cores, federation layers, ML systems, digital twins, evidence systems and future computational/quantum research engines.
control_principle: Observe -> map -> model -> cross-test -> fault-learn -> optimise -> verify -> anchor -> promote.

canonical_representation.rule: Code remains an executable implementation artifact; computational geometry is the canonical machine-readable representation for system analysis, relationships, behaviour and optimisation.
canonical_representation.geometry_model: Represent every system as a multidimensional computational graph/hypergraph whose nodes and edges encode code units, interfaces, capabilities, dependencies, states, behaviour, resources, evidence and provenance.
canonical_representation.rule_for_mapping: Every mapped code element must resolve to a semantic geometry node and its relationships must resolve to typed edges.
canonical_representation.negative_space: Absent, blocked, unavailable, forbidden, quarantined and unverified paths are first-class geometry states rather than omitted information.

shared_engine_model.principle: All ML systems share a common Buipui Intelligence core engine and scale through modular engines, datasets, geometry maps and platform adapters.

scaling.horizontal: Add independent system families, modules and federation participants without changing the core contract.
scaling.vertical: Move the same semantic model from application level through native core, hardware interface and future specialised engines.
scaling.heterogeneous: Permit different languages, runtimes, platforms and architectures to participate through typed contracts and adapters.

buipui_intelligence.role: Primary reasoning, learning, optimisation and orchestration layer.
buipui_intelligence.function: Optimise all registered engines and system families against common functionality, evidence and resource objectives.

computational_geometry_engine.role: Canonical multidimensional representation and traversal layer.
computational_geometry_engine.function: Map code and system behaviour into geometry rather than treating source text as the only representation.

quantum_physics_engine.function: Evaluate superposition-like alternative states, multidimensional paths, optimisation spaces and constrained state transitions.
quantum_physics_engine.boundary: Software simulation or abstraction must not be represented as proof of physical quantum behaviour.

quanticor.role: Quantum-level observation, fault-learning, multidimensional mapping and optimisation controller.

buipui_heterogeneous_system.function: Maintain a machine-readable model of heterogeneous systems so AI can traverse, compare and test system states without assuming a single implementation language or platform.

learning_engine.role: Shared ML learning and regression layer.
learning_engine.function: Learn from observed behaviour, test evidence, faults, recoveries and performance rather than inferring correctness from source structure alone.

quantum_federation_control.role: Controlled federation protocol for multi-system state exploration.
principles: Alternative system states may be represented simultaneously in the computational model.
Conflicting implementations are compared before promotion.
Intentional collisions occur only in sandbox/quarantine environments.
Verified clean paths are separated from experimental and failed paths.

collision_protocol.goal: Expose interface, semantic, dependency, resource and behavioural conflicts.
collision_protocol.production_rule: No destructive collision is permitted against an authoritative build.

code_decomposition.principle: Non-required, redundant or conflicting code is decomposed and classified before any deletion or replacement.
code_decomposition.promotion_rule: No code is deleted solely because an optimiser labels it redundant; evidence, provenance and human-approved promotion remain required.

system_interlinking.principle: Buipui systems are interlinked through machine-readable contracts and multidimensional geometry while preserving independent operation.

architecture_trees.as_is_functionality_tree: Preserve existing systems and maximise verified functionality without premature restructuring.
architecture_trees.buipui_native_systems_tree: Core-integrated performance and optimisation tree built only from verified functionality.
architecture_trees.archive_tree: Immutable historical builds and evidence retained as control references.

evidence_and_blockchain.blockchain_role: Integrity/provenance anchor for geometry-map snapshots, experiment events, regression states and promotion evidence.
evidence_and_blockchain.rule: Blockchain is an anchor and audit layer, not the sole data store.

optimisation_protocol.constraint: Performance optimisation cannot override functional correctness, safety gates or provenance.

machine_readable_principles: Geometry represents system relationships; source code remains the executable implementation.
Learn from behaviour and evidence, not source assumptions alone.
Every system can evaluate another system through controlled contracts.
Native functionality is preferred when it satisfies the contract.
Federation is used when independent systems must interoperate.
All ML systems share the Buipui Intelligence core engine and scale through modular extensions.
Quantum models are computational/research abstractions unless physical evidence establishes otherwise.
Clean paths and failed paths remain separately traceable.
Blockchain anchors provenance but does not replace the evidence store.
No promotion occurs without reproducible evidence.

research_tracks.photonic_intelligence: Research only until physical architecture and evidence exist.
research_tracks.crystal_intelligence: Research only until physical architecture and evidence exist.
research_tracks.microbial_mapping: Cross-reference existing Biupui research/IP evidence without claiming capabilities beyond recorded evidence.
